title: It is part of the Sunnah that when the muezzin says in the Adhan of the Fajr prayer: Come to success, he then says: Prayer is better than sleep
hadeeth: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: It is part of the Sunnah that when the muezzin says in the Adhan of the Fajr prayer: Come to success, he then says: Prayer is better than sleep.
attribution: Narrated by Ibn Khuzaymah, Ad-Daaraqutni, and Al-Bayhaqi
explanation: Anas ibn Mālik (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that among what the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) established in his Sunnah is that the muezzin should say during the call to the Fajr prayer, specifically after saying "Come to success", the phrase: "Prayer is better than sleep".
hints: His statement (it is part of the Sunnah): means it is the Sunnah of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him), so it carries the ruling of a Marfū‘ (elevated) report, i.e., it is attributed to the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him).

It is recommended for the muezzin to say, in the call to the Fajr prayer, after "Come to success": "Prayer is better than sleep" twice because the Fajr prayer comes at a time when most people are asleep and rise from their sleep to pray. Therefore, this phrase is specific to Fajr and not included in the other prayer calls.
hadeeth_intro: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضيَ اللهُ عنه قَالَ: مِنَ السُّنَّةِ إِذَا قَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، قَالَ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ.
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضيَ اللهُ عنه قَالَ:
explanation_ar: أخبر أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه، أن مما أقره النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في سنته، أن يقول المؤذن في أذان الفجر خاصة، بعد قوله: (حي على الفلاح)، أن يقول:  (الصلاة خير من النوم).
hints_ar: قوله (من السنة): يعني سنة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، فله حكم الرفع، أي المنسوب إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.
استحباب أن يقول المؤذن في أذان الفجر بعد: حي على الفلاح: الصلاة خير من النوم، مرتين؛ لأن صلاة الفجر في وقت ينام فيه عامة الناس، ويقومون إلى الصلاة من نوم، فاختصت صلاة الفجر بذلك دون غيرها من الصلوات.
